description: Capture evidence for a URL with a real browser: runtime HTML, full-page screenshots, DOM and computed-style summaries, assets, network/HAR metadata, interactions, and optional desktop/tablet/mobile breakpoints. With output_dir and capture_html it also writes an offline HTML snapshot. Use when you will build or verify a page yourself.

breakpoint_profiles.description: Extra viewports to capture and verify: desktop (1440x1200), tablet (768x1024), mobile (390x844). Example: ["tablet", "mobile"].

capture_html.description: Include the rendered runtime HTML in the capture.

capture_screenshot.description: Take a full-page PNG screenshot (needed for visual verification).

exact_requested.description: True (default) when the user wants an exact, faithful clone; false when an approximate rebuild is acceptable.

include_runtime_trace.description: Launch a real browser for runtime capture (default true). False limits the result to static HTML inspection.

license_text.description: License or permission text that allows reusing the page, from the user or the site; informs the reuse/rebuild policy.

output_dir.description: Directory to write capture artifacts, generated files, and reports into; created if missing.

source_signals.description: Extra hints about the page's origin, e.g. ["framer", "spline", "export"]; merged with signals detected from the page.

storage_state_output_path.description: Path to write the browser storage state after capture, so the session can be reused.

storage_state_path.description: Path to a Playwright storage-state JSON (cookies, localStorage) to load before capture, for pages behind a login the user owns.

timeout_seconds.description: Timeout in seconds for the static HTTP fetch of the page.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the page to inspect, capture, or clone.

user_data_dir.description: Path to an existing Chrome profile directory, to capture a page behind a login the user owns. Omit for a clean session.

viewport_height.description: Primary browser viewport height in CSS pixels (default 1200).

viewport_width.description: Primary browser viewport width in CSS pixels (default 1440).

wait_seconds.description: Upper bound in seconds for each browser readiness wait (load, network quiet, lazy-load scroll); capture continues as soon as the page settles.

name: capture_reference_bundle
